summary: TransAlta Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing results of its 2026 Annual and Special Meeting of Shareholders held on April 30, 2026. The meeting covered routine items: election of nine director nominees (all elected with 92.54%-99.64% support), appointment of Ernst & Young LLP as auditors (99.19% for), advisory vote on executive compensation (96.69% for), and approval to increase shares under the Share Unit Plan (98.53% for). No special-situation event, such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review, is present. This is a routine filing of meeting results with no material corporate action.
